Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using specially crafted CSV text files exploiting Microsoft Excel's Dynamic Data Exchange (DDE) feature to execute PowerShell commands that download and execute malware DLLs
Use of WMIC.exe to launch PowerShell scripts that download and execute malicious DLLs
Impacted Systems: Windows devices in corporate and government networks
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with links to download malicious CSV files containing DDE commands
Execution of malicious PowerShell scripts via DDE in Excel
Indicators of Compromise: Execution of rundll32.exe on the downloaded DLL
Telemetry showing 102 non-sandbox corporate and government victims over two days
